title: Farlands
body:
While they aren't as spectacular as the Farlands from Beta 1.7.3 (probably due to the worldgen datapacks in use), the Farlands do exist in Disorder of the Stone. They currently start 12 million blocks out. If players would like them moved closer, let us know on the [Discord server]({{links.discord}}).
